And if what shows up is the protective part, let it have the clumsy hand first.

t65r_sp5p2a: It won't turn the memory into fiction, and it won't prove you remember it right. Keep an ear on whoever's telling it. If the narrator starts to sneer, stop. The same goes for coming out of it more ashamed, or feeling like none of it is real, and backing further away from the memory won't fix that. When the phrase helps, keep it to that one line.
